label: polarize · MSA
purpose: Stacked-consensus MSA viewer for inversion polarization. First cartridge of the evolution stage. Reuses the dosage-heatmap painter — each 'sample' is one consensus row (outgroup, INV founder-like, INV subgroups by 2D-SFS doubleton clustering, STD). Confidence + reason tier per site.
input_contract: atlasState.inversion.polarize_msa_state = { dosage, n_markers, n_samples, inv_idx, std_idx?, outgroup_idx?, marker_labels?, ... }
subdir_files: builder.js — build consensus-row stack feeding dosage-heatmap renderer
renderer.js — thin adapter feeding row-stack into dosage-heatmap painter + tier-confidence stripe
selection.js — hover {row, col, marker_idx, sample_idx} (sample_idx = row-stack position; 0=outgroup, 1=INV founder, ...)
computed_preview_outputs: stacked-consensus MSA: outgroup row + INV founder-like + per-subgroup consensus rows + STD consensus row + tier-confidence stripe

specs_todo: unknown — implements evolution-stage SPEC concepts; no top-level SPEC file
